description:
## Goal

Enable prompt-manager team agents to express a preferred option and confidence level when submitting multi-option decisions, and surface this recommendation prominently in the approval UI.

## Implementation

### API Changes
- Add `recommended` field to DecisionOption (or top-level `recommended_key` on the decision)
- Add `confidence` field (0.0-1.0) expressing agent's confidence in the recommendation
- Add `recommendation_rationale` field for why the agent recommends this option
- Update `AppendDecision()` to accept and validate recommendation fields
- Approval enforcement: recommendations are advisory only — agents still cannot auto-approve in approval mode

### UI Changes
- Highlight recommended option visually (e.g., outlined, starred, or labeled "Recommended")
- Show confidence indicator (high/medium/low based on score)
- Show recommendation rationale inline (not hidden behind hover)
- Default selection to recommended option (user can override before confirming)

### Team Agent Integration
- Update heartbeat decision protocol so agents can include recommendation metadata
- Document the recommendation fields in team guidelines

## Key Files

- Decision model: `scenarios/prompt-manager/api/store/models.go` — add recommended/confidence fields
- Handlers: `scenarios/prompt-manager/api/heartbeat/handlers.go` — validate recommendation fields
- UI: `scenarios/prompt-manager/ui/src/components/editor/teamTabs/DecisionLogView.tsx` — render recommendations
- Service: `scenarios/prompt-manager/ui/src/services/heartbeatService.ts` — pass recommendation data
name: prompt-manager-agent-recommendations
title: Add Agent Recommendation Support to Prompt-Manager Decisions
